description: We are ASM Space Pioneers, a creative team of Grade 5 students from Al Salam Charter School, Abu Dhabi. We are excited to explore science, technology and NASA data to solve real-world problems. Our team enjoys coding, AI, design, research and learning about Earth and space. We believe curiosity, creativity and teamwork can turn great ideas into meaningful solutions.
summary:
ASM Space Pioneers: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive space-learning project created by four Grade 5 students from Al Salam Charter School, Abu Dhabi, for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

Inspired by the theme The Next Frontier, our project explores an important question: How can future astronauts prepare for the challenges of living and working on Mars?

We developed two connected educational tools: Mission Mars, an interactive game created using Scratch, and ASM Space Pioneers Buddy, an AI-powered learning chatbot.

Through six exciting missions, players experience Mars landing, mineral exploration, habitat repair, dust storms, scientific investigation, and a final knowledge challenge. They must make decisions, manage simulated survival resources, and solve problems.

Our chatbot complements the game by explaining Mars science, life-support systems, and engineering decisions using NASA educational resources.

Our goal is to transform complex space exploration concepts into accessible, engaging learning experiences that inspire curiosity, critical thinking, creativity, and future careers in STEM.

We believe tomorrow's space explorers can begin their journey in today's classrooms.
details:
ASM Space Pioneers – Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

Our project is an interactive Mars exploration experience developed by four Grade 5 students from Al Salam Charter School, Abu Dhabi, for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

We created Mission Mars, a Scratch-based game featuring six exciting missions, including Mars landing, mineral exploration, habitat rescue, dust storm survival, scientific research, and a Mars knowledge quiz. Players solve challenges, make decisions, and manage simulated survival resources.

We also developed ASM Space Pioneers Buddy, an AI-powered chatbot using Edcafe AI that helps learners understand Mars exploration, astronaut safety, and survival challenges through NASA science resources.

Our project combines coding, AI, NASA science, and game-based learning to develop critical thinking, creativity, and problem-solving skills.

Our vision is to inspire young learners worldwide to become future scientists, engineers, and space explorers.

“We don't just imagine the future. We train for it!”
